title: Semiconductor Design Services Accelerate Silicon with Wipro
summary: Wipro enables turnkey silicon development through semiconductor design services, leveraging AI assisted design verification and manufacturing partnerships
body_markdown:
Wipro’s Turnkey Silicon Design and Turnkey Silicon Device solutions leverage Wipro’s 25-year experience in silicon development, with expertise cutting across a breadth of industry verticals, to transform semiconductor product development landscape.


Wipro Turnkey Silicon solution enables semiconductor product companies and OEMs to reduce semiconductor design and development costs by 25-30% and cut time to silicon production release cycle times by upto 50% depending on the type of semiconductor device application. By leveraging Wipro’s proprietary Eaglewision silicon engineering flow, that has over 25 patents granted, with AI assisted RTL code generation, design verification, bug remediation, and automated layout fixes and optimization, Wipro Turnkey silicon delivers high quality first time right silicon design to production.


Among its many benefits, Wipro’s Turnkey Silicon Design and Device development flow


- Improves silicon engineering productivity resulting in lower silicon development cost and cycle times for our clients


- Provides predictable first time right semiconductor production release with low risk


- Leverages Wipro’s partner ecosystem comprising industry leading fabs, OSATs, IP providers to provide best in class end to end semiconductor development services.


Our silicon vendor and OEM customers across applications such as High Performance Computing, Industrial, Telecom / Networking, Automotive, and Medical Devices have an opportunity to leverage Wipro’s Turnkey Silicon Design and Device development capabilities to develop derivative products to address adjacent market opportunities, develop a custom ASIC solution for an innovative new application, or for optimizing the overall system BOM cost or form factor.
